reference: She refused to leave the shop without the green jumpsuit.
sk: Odmietla opustiť obchod bez toho zeleného overalu.
cz: Odmítla opustit obchod bez toho zeleného overalu.
acceptable: She refused to leave the {shop|store} without {the|that} green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
She refused to walk out of the {shop|store} without {the|that} green {jumpsuit|overalls}.

mistakes.text: She refused leaving the {shop|store} without the green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „refuse“ patrí Infinitive s „to“: „refused to leave“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „refuse“ následuje Infinitive s „to“: „refused to leave“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Refuse” is followed by the Infinitive with “to”: “refused to leave”.

mistakes.text: She refused to leave from the {shop|store} without the green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Leave” takes a direct object here, with no “from”.

mistakes.text: She refused to leave the {shop|store} without green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Chýba člen „the“: ide o konkrétny overal.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Chybí člen „the“: jde o konkrétní overal.
mistakes.feedback_en: “The” is missing: it's one particular item.

mistakes.text: She refused to left the {shop|store} without the green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „to“ patrí holý tvar slovesa: „to leave“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „to“ následuje holý tvar slovesa: „to leave“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “to” use the bare verb: “to leave”.

mistakes.text: She didn't want to leave the {shop|store} without the green {jumpsuit|overalls}.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Refused to” matches the meaning more exactly.
